future_native_WNN_fit.important_distinction: A graph can be target-label-unexposed yet still be target-feature-fitted and transductive. The former does not justify a frozen-inductive claim.

future_reference_mapping.rule: A separately registered method must prove that no labels or target modalities leak and must report query-composition dependence.

gse296875.held_donor_rule: If held-donor RNA or ATAC enters WNN weighting or graph construction, the held representation is transductive. Observed held ATAC is forbidden for rna_conditioned_atac.

leakage_and_identity_incidents.finding: FindMultiModalNeighbors estimates cell-specific modality weights and neighbor graphs from the rows and modality reductions in the supplied object.
Native WNN requires the same ordered cells or nuclei to have every modality used for weighting and neighbor construction.
Native WNN uses observed query ATAC when ATAC is one of the query reductions.
Seurat multimodal reference mapping and bridge integration use separate functions and query/anchor geometry.
A missing ATAC modality can be represented in a matrix as zeros even though no assay was observed.

remaining_blockers: Keep seurat_wnn unscheduled for rna_conditioned_atac because it is latent-only and exposes observed query ATAC rather than predicting a profile.
Keep seurat_wnn out of sealed cell_state_mapping because GSE289173 is RNA only and native WNN has no frozen RNA-only transform.
Register any multimodal reference-mapping, bridge, donor-aggregate, latent-retrieval, or label-transfer analysis as a distinct method and nonpromotable TaskSpec before fitting.
Validate the exact well-namespaced GSE296875 same-nucleus barcode-to-donor join; reject all false GSE244832 cell or nucleus pairs.
Freeze outer-donor preprocessing, feature sets, reductions, dimensions, WNN parameters, row order, approximate-neighbor implementation, seeds, threads, output schema, and dependency lock.
Pass CPU-SLURM row-permutation, donor-fold isolation, missing-modality, false-pair, query-composition, deterministic-neighbor, export/reload, and memory fixtures after explicit campaign approval.
Audit dependency and project-output redistribution terms before releasing any fitted graph, reduction, embedding, or index.
claim_boundary: No frozen transfer, RNA-to-ATAC prediction, MASLD champion, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment-response, clinical-decision, or deployment claim.
